值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解為什麼挑選距離太遠的設計公司，可能影響工程監工與施工品質。
  • 看懂跨縣市裝修容易增加的費用，以及工班交通時間如何拉長工期。
  • 掌握入住後維修的實際難題，作為挑選設計公司與承包團隊的參考。

摘要

找熟悉的設計公司，未必是最方便的選擇

在「老司機」系列中，九向作者談起自己的煩惱：她在台北工作，老家則在台中，房子逐漸老舊，需要整修。她想請熟識的同事協助設計與裝修；作者則提醒，若公司在台中沒有據點，選擇距離超過一小時車程的設計公司，最好先仔細考慮。

距離影響監工，也可能增加成本

作者提出的第一個理由是監工安排容易受交通時間限制。以台北到台中為例，往返可能耗去四小時，若工作又有其他變數，設計師留給工地的時間就很有限。有些工序，例如防水施工，必須到場確認，單靠視訊並不能取代所有現場檢查。作者也補充，監工不必天天到場才代表負責，真正重要的是有明確的圖面與適時的巡查。

第二個理由是裝修費用可能上升。設計公司可能將交通成本列入報價，或調高監工費；若工班也從外縣市出發，交通時間會壓縮實際工作時數，增加他們承接其他工作的難度，額外成本最後仍可能反映在業主的費用上。作者建議，屋主可以直接詢問設計公司是否有當地合作工班，並確認對方的回答是否實在。

工期與後續維修都可能受拖累

第三個理由是施工期可能延長。若工班每天花大量時間往返，實際施工時數減少，原本預計十天完成的工程，可能因此拖得更久。讓工班住在當地或許可行，但住宿費用最終仍可能轉嫁給業主；對於只需施工幾天的工項，工班也未必願意如此安排。

第四個理由是入住後維修不便。房屋完工後，住上一段時間才發現需要調整門鉸、鎖緊螺絲或處理其他小問題，是常見情況。若設計公司或工班遠在外地，他們可能無法立即專程回來處理，屋主往往得等待對方有空，或等他們剛好到附近辦事時再安排。作者以冷氣故障為例說明，像這類需要及時處理的問題，找附近的服務團隊通常更有效率。

選擇前先衡量距離帶來的代價

綜合監工、費用、工期與維修四方面，作者建議屋主重新評估距離工地超過一小時車程的設計公司。公司看起來專業、自己也信任熟人，並不代表遠距服務一定合適；若仍決定委託，就應事先做好花費較高、工期較長、後續支援較不即時的心理準備。

================================================

Second, I think renovation costs will definitely rise. This cost increase comes from two areas : first, travel expenses, which some design firms roll into the total quote for long-distance projects. >> Oh, so you mean they might just add a line item for travel expenses in the quote? >> Some do write it that way. >> Hmm.

>> Others don’t. Some might just increase the supervision fee instead. Oh. >> Because I know my supervision costs will naturally involve more travel expenses than usual. >> And time costs as well. >> So, a 10%supervision fee might turn into 12%or 15%. >> Hmm. >> All of that is possible. So, that cost will definitely go up; second, the contractor's labor costs will also increase. Let’s just assume it’s Taipei and Taichung. If the project site is in Taichung. But you hire a design firm in Taipei, so let's assume all their contractors are based in Taipei. >> Do you think these contractors will just add a travel fee when they see the location is Taichung? >> Isn't it just a travel expense? >> No, where did you get such an optimistic idea? Contractors don't usually calculate it that way, because if you want me to go down there, it’s even pricier if there’s only a small amount of work. >> Oh. Right, and even if it’s not a small amount, it’s still the same. Because. just going there costs money. Some contractors work eight hours a day; maybe they could finish this job in five days and move to the next, meaning they could do two jobs in ten days. But if they come to you, the travel time increases, so maybe they can only work four hours a day. It becomes one job every two days, so they earn less, right? >> Oh, so it's like they're building the cost of the next job into this one. You don’t have to hire them; it’s a voluntary agreement.

If I’m the design firm, I’ll pass those costs on because I’m not going to absorb them. >> So your costs will be higher. You could ask one more question: even though they are a Taipei firm, do they have local partners or contractors in Taichung? >> An honest one will tell you the truth. >> A dishonest one will say yes even if they don't. >> Anyway, the money is coming out of your pocket. >> Exactly, the cost falls on you. An honest one will tell you, "No, my crew has to come down from Taipei." It’s worth asking. >> Mhm. >> Theoretically, it will always be more expensive; the costs will be higher. >> But this increase isn't the design firm trying to overcharge; it's because their costs have actually gone up. >> Because the contractors feel they are putting in much more effort. >> Mhm. Third point. Construction time will definitely be extended. It’s the same logic: if I only work four hours a day because the other four are spent driving , a job that should take ten days now takes twenty. Won’t the timeline be extended? So... >> But what if the community allows access at 8 AM? Shouldn't the contractors be able to start early? >> I have no idea. Well, there's one way, there's a way where they just stay locally. Because if they're there long-term, they might rent a place. >> They would just rent a small studio apartment. >> Yeah, wouldn't that solve the problem? >> Or stay in one of those cheaper hotels. >> Hmm. >> Whose cost is it? Who pays for it? >> The worker has to live there, so the worker. >> Right, the worker pays, or the boss pays . But would the boss just pay for it willingly?

In the end, it's billed to you; their costs go up, so you're indirectly paying for it anyway. For long-term jobs like carpentry, it might be cost-effective, but for three, five, or ten-day jobs, they won't rent. They'll say, "I have to run back and forth, I have a family and kids to take care of, I don't want to do that," so your construction time will definitely be extended. >> Oh. >> That is bound to happen. Hmm. >> The fourth point. The last one is that repairs will become a huge hassle. We say that once you move in, everything will eventually break. >> Hmm. >> It’s just a matter of time. Sometimes, even if everything is fine when we finish, you have to live there for a while to realize, "Oh, this needs an adjustment," or "The screw came loose ." Nobody wants to make a special trip just for that, but you have to actually use it to know. Hmm. >> And if you call them then, wow. Even if it's just to tighten a screw or adjust a hinge. " >> I'm not going back, I'm done with the whole thing." >> Exactly, and they're in Taipei. "I have to drive two hours from Taipei just to fix this?" They will, but they'll tell you, "It's not that urgent." "Can it wait until I'm free?" And "when I'm free" could mean... >> Half a month or a month later, when they happen to be in the area doing something else. Of course, our design firm will try to find a way. We’ll ask around to see if any local crews can help out, but as I said, that's...

>> Not exactly reliable, you know? It’s like what I often tell homeowners about their HVAC contractor: if you're out of town, it's best to find one nearby. Because in the summer... >> When your AC breaks down and you need repairs, if you realize you hired a contractor from far away, wow, it's really hard to get them to come to the rescue. Oh, it's too late, they're too far. >> Right, we want to get the repairs finished as quickly as possible, especially with the air conditioning; the heat is unbearable otherwise. That’s why I’m saying the repair time will end up being dragged out. So, you see, I’ve analyzed these four points. If a project site or design firm is more than an hour's drive away, I suggest you reconsider. Don't end up spending more time and money while getting no added value in service. >> Things always get delayed, but it’s not that they want to; you just don't know why you insisted on choosing someone so. far away. >> You just think, "Oh, this company looks impressive," so you want to hire them. Well, you need to be mentally prepared for that. I think if you're prepared, it doesn't matter, but many people forget to consider these factors when choosing a design firm, so I think this is quite important. But it’s okay, our company is in Taichung. >> Oh, right, yes, yes, yes. >> Our company is in Taichung, Zhubei, and we have two locations in Taipei. >> Right, so you see. We really do get inquiries from Kaohsiung. >> Yeah, a lot, from Kaohsiung and Tainan.

>> I can't manage that. Don't just take on a project for the sake of getting the work. >> Driving down from Taichung to handle it . Right, I won't do that; I won't do that. It's the same for Tainan. I always tell the homeowners that I know people locally whom I can recommend, because I am currently based in Taichung. The furthest I go is within an hour of Taichung, like Changhua, but Tainan, Pingtung, and Kaohsiung are just not feasible. So, hiring an out-of-town designer isn't impossible, but you need to evaluate it clearly. If you can accept the trade-offs, then go for it. 值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解為什麼挑選距離太遠的設計公司，可能影響工程監工與施工品質。
  • 看懂跨縣市裝修容易增加的費用，以及工班交通時間如何拉長工期。
  • 掌握入住後維修的實際難題，作為挑選設計公司與承包團隊的參考。

摘要

找熟悉的設計公司，未必是最方便的選擇

在「老司機」系列中，九向作者談起自己的煩惱：她在台北工作，老家則在台中，房子逐漸老舊，需要整修。她想請熟識的同事協助設計與裝修；作者則提醒，若公司在台中沒有據點，選擇距離超過一小時車程的設計公司，最好先仔細考慮。

距離影響監工，也可能增加成本

作者提出的第一個理由是監工安排容易受交通時間限制。以台北到台中為例，往返可能耗去四小時，若工作又有其他變數，設計師留給工地的時間就很有限。有些工序，例如防水施工，必須到場確認，單靠視訊並不能取代所有現場檢查。作者也補充，監工不必天天到場才代表負責，真正重要的是有明確的圖面與適時的巡查。

第二個理由是裝修費用可能上升。設計公司可能將交通成本列入報價，或調高監工費；若工班也從外縣市出發，交通時間會壓縮實際工作時數，增加他們承接其他工作的難度，額外成本最後仍可能反映在業主的費用上。作者建議，屋主可以直接詢問設計公司是否有當地合作工班，並確認對方的回答是否實在。

工期與後續維修都可能受拖累

第三個理由是施工期可能延長。若工班每天花大量時間往返，實際施工時數減少，原本預計十天完成的工程，可能因此拖得更久。讓工班住在當地或許可行，但住宿費用最終仍可能轉嫁給業主；對於只需施工幾天的工項，工班也未必願意如此安排。

第四個理由是入住後維修不便。房屋完工後，住上一段時間才發現需要調整門鉸、鎖緊螺絲或處理其他小問題，是常見情況。若設計公司或工班遠在外地，他們可能無法立即專程回來處理，屋主往往得等待對方有空，或等他們剛好到附近辦事時再安排。作者以冷氣故障為例說明，像這類需要及時處理的問題，找附近的服務團隊通常更有效率。

選擇前先衡量距離帶來的代價

綜合監工、費用、工期與維修四方面，作者建議屋主重新評估距離工地超過一小時車程的設計公司。公司看起來專業、自己也信任熟人，並不代表遠距服務一定合適；若仍決定委託，就應事先做好花費較高、工期較長、後續支援較不即時的心理準備。
